get.description: counting=space-model deduplicates each model within a space and reads dedicated Non-IDB fields. It requires exact UTC dates and returns coverage, model labels, resolved scope and range. Legacy callers without counting retain the original surface tally. Query `mode` (idspace|idb, default idb) selects the doughnut-primary field per the FE contract: `mode=idspace` -> the response's `spaces` field (per tooth-surface occurrence tally); `mode=idb` -> the response's `usage` field (per-score, per-model presence). The response always includes both `usage` and `spaces` (plus `byFamily`/`totals`) regardless of mode, and echoes the resolved `mode` back so the FE knows which field is primary — it is never silently dropped. Query `family` (all|prime|perio|non-idb, default all) narrows `usage`/`spaces` to one brush family; the wire value is hyphenated ("non-idb") per the contract, mapped internally to the response's `byFamily.nonIdb` key.

dental-status.description: Legacy wizard step payloads grouped by score part.

valid.description: Whether the wizard step passed client-side validation.

dental-status.description: Legacy per-step validation metadata from the mobile wizard.

picture.description: Base64 image or uploaded file reference for the mouth picture captured in the final wizard step.

fileType.description: Original client-side file extension/type for the mouth picture.

pictureApproved.description: Whether the coach approved the captured mouth picture before submission.

brushInner.description: Brush score for the lingual/palatal (inside) surface.

brushOuter.description: Brush score for the buccal/facial (outside) surface.

insertionInner.description: IDB insertion technique on the lingual/palatal (inside) surface. Ignored when that side has no interdental brush.

insertionOuter.description: IDB insertion technique on the buccal/facial (outside) surface. Ignored when that side has no interdental brush.

from.description: FDI number of the first anchor.

to.description: FDI number of the other anchor. Must differ from `from` and sit in the same arch.

from.description: FDI number of the first tooth.

to.description: FDI number of the last tooth. Must differ from `from` and sit in the same arch.

side.description: `outer` = buccal / labial side of the arch, `inner` = palatal / lingual side.

kind.description: `retainer` (default when omitted) or `braces`. Braces are always on the `outer` side.

score.description: Calculated subtotal for the dental-status section.

bleeding-index.description: Calculated bleeding-index subtotal inside the dental-status section.

final.description: Final BOB score calculated by the legacy mobile wizard.

dental-status.description: Per-section score breakdown from the legacy mobile wizard.

key.description: Catalog product key, or the app-side id of a clinician custom tool.

name.description: Product name snapshotted at prescription time.

imageUrl.description: Root-relative image URL snapshotted at prescription time.

tabName.description: Catalog tab name snapshotted at prescription time.

packageQuantity.description: Catalog package quantity snapshotted at prescription time.

packageUnit.description: Catalog package unit snapshotted at prescription time.

code.description: BPE code 0..4. Omit/null when the sextant is not scored.

prf.description: PRF modifier, ORed into overallPrf on scored sextants. When `furcation` is omitted it also stands for the furcation mark (older app payloads).

furcation.description: Furcation involvement observed in this sextant.

plaqueRetentiveFactors.description: Specific plaque-retentive factors observed in this sextant.

steps.description: DEPRECATED — use `bobScore.steps`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

meta.description: DEPRECATED — use `bobScore.meta`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

bleedingStatus.description: DEPRECATED — use `bobScore.bleedingStatus`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

fdiSchema.description: 32-slot array of per-tooth FDI status. Legacy mobile payloads may contain `null` placeholders for unused positions.

bridges.description: Dental bridges drawn on the mouth map, as anchor pairs. Orthogonal to `fdiSchema`: the teeth a bridge spans keep their own entries and nothing here feeds scoring. Omit the field to leave stored bridges untouched; send `[]` to clear them.

retainers.description: Retainers drawn on the mouth map, as tooth pairs with a side. Orthogonal to `fdiSchema` and to `bridges`; nothing here feeds scoring. Omit the field to leave stored retainers untouched; send `[]` to clear them.

bobScore.description: BOB Index block. Older payloads sending score/steps/meta/bleedingStatus/prescription flat at the `data` level are still accepted and collected in here when stored.

score.description: DEPRECATED — use `bobScore.score`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

prescription.description: DEPRECATED — use `bobScore.prescription`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps. Home-care prescription snapshot taken at save time: name/image frozen so later catalog edits or deletions cannot rewrite old prescriptions.

bpe.description: BPE screening input (type=bpe): up to six sextants. The mouth map is taken from `fdiSchema`; the server derives auto-exclusion + the overall result and ignores any client-computed totals.

noBleedingSpaces.description: BOB Index spaces the clinician marked "no bleeding" over a bleeding pre-fill from the last session (the Eraser on a pre-filled ring). `fdiSchema` stores such a space like any space without bleeding, so an In Progress session needs this list to resume it as "no bleeding" instead of pre-filling it again. Stored as sent; nothing here feeds scoring. Send `[]` to clear it.

type.description: DEPRECATED — use `assessments`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

assessments.description: Assessments this session contains. Omit to derive it from `type` and from the `data` block.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the session (device time). Must be unique per patient+type.

recommendation.description: Coach recommendation. Pass null to clear.

duration.description: Examination duration in seconds. Must be >= 0.

type.description: DEPRECATED — use `assessments`. Score type (p1 | bleeding). Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

assessments.description: Assessments may only be ADDED. A list missing an assessment the session already has → 400.

meta.description: Session metadata. All sub-fields optional — only send what needs to change.

data.description: Score payload — same shape as create. Providing this block upserts the stored payload record. `rawData` is deep-merged into the stored payload: nested keys you omit are preserved, only the keys you send are overwritten. `fdiSchema` is replaced wholesale, and only when explicitly provided.

scores.description: Array of score objects to resend

email.description: Deprecated — ignored. The score report is always sent to the patient's own stored email address.

fdiSchema.description: 32-slot array of per-tooth baseline FDI status (missing, crown, implant, ...). Legacy mobile payloads may contain `null` placeholders for unused positions.

bridges.description: Dental bridges on the baseline mouth map, as anchor pairs. Orthogonal to `fdiSchema` — see `BridgeDto`. Omit the field to leave stored bridges untouched (so an older app that does not know about bridges cannot wipe them); send `[]` to clear them.

retainers.description: Retainers on the baseline mouth map, as tooth pairs with a side — see `RetainerDto`. Omit the field to leave stored retainers untouched (so an app that does not know about retainers cannot wipe them); send `[]` to clear them.

practiceId.description: Practice the temp patient belongs to

type.description: DEPRECATED — use `assessments`. Still accepted for backward compatibility with older apps.

assessments.description: Assessments this session contains. Omit to derive it from `type` and from the `data` block.

sourcePatientId.description: Temporary patient whose single session will be adopted

targetPatientId.description: Existing (non-temporary) patient to receive the session

packageQuantity.description: Catalog package size. Send together with packageUnit; omit/null both when unspecified.

packageUnit.description: Catalog package unit (for example pcs, box, pack, tube, bottle, set). Send together with packageQuantity.

countryUrls.description: Country code (ISO alpha-2) -> webshop URL map. A practice's country picks its link; a country without one gets defaultUrl. Sent whole: it replaces the product's country links.

packageQuantity.description: Catalog package size. Send together with packageUnit; omit/null both when unspecified.

packageUnit.description: Catalog package unit (for example pcs, box, pack, tube, bottle, set). Send together with packageQuantity.

countryUrls.description: Country code (ISO alpha-2) -> webshop URL map. A practice's country picks its link; a country without one gets defaultUrl. Sent whole: it replaces the product's country links.

imageAssetId.description: Asset id from POST /assets. Explicit null clears the product image.

defaultUrl.description: Explicit null clears the default webshop URL.

productIds.description: All product uuids in the tab, in the desired display order (must be an exact-match reshuffle of the current products in that tab).

tabIds.description: All product tab uuids, in the desired display order (must be an exact-match reshuffle of the current tabs).

productId.description: Product uuid (the admin product `id`). null clears it.

refillProductId.description: Refill product uuid (the admin product `id`). null clears it.

items.description: Any subset of the BOB values; each listed value is set as given, unlisted values are left unchanged.

shortDescription.example: Short announcement shown in the news list.

content.example: Full article body shown on the news detail screen.

imageAssetId.description: Asset id for the news image (from POST /assets).

shortDescription.example: Short announcement shown in the news list.

content.example: Full article body shown on the news detail screen.

imageAssetId.description: Asset id for the news image (from POST /assets).

translations.description: Text per language code, e.g. {"en": "...", "de": "..."}. en is required; blank languages are dropped. Full replacement on update.

example.en: Use the interdental brush once a day every day.

active.description: Defaults to true on create; kept unchanged on update when omitted.

ids.description: Every template id, in the desired display order (must be an exact-match reshuffle of the current templates).

expectedSubsidiaryId.description: The source subsidiary reviewed by the operator; null means unassigned.

email.description: Required so approved staff receive their one-time temporary password directly.

asOf.description: Evaluate the switch rule as of this instant instead of now (ISO 8601). Rehearsals use it to move the 7-day windows without waiting.
